items.title: 4.1.5.1 Breadth-First Search Algorithm (BFS) in Graph (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of BFS with the zoo example (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: BFS tree ya graph ko aise khangalta hai ke agle level se pehle maujooda level ke tamam nodes dekhta hai. Aisa zoo dekhna jis ke ahaate raaston se jure hon: darwaze (start node) se shuru kar ke use queue mein dalein; queue ke aage wala ahata dekhein, us ke parosi ahaate dhoond kar enqueue karein; queue ke agle ahaate par ja kar dohrayein; queue khali ho to har ahata dekha ja chuka.

blocks.prompt: Zoo wale tareeqe mein stack ki bajaye queue kyun?
blocks.explanation: Queue ahaate usi tarteeb mein dikhati hai jis mein woh mile, to qareebi ahaate door walon se pehle, level ba level.

items: BFS: start node queue mein; dequeue, dekho, parosi enqueue; queue khali ho to ruko.
